rows.grounds: bodily winds or disorders as object
first member of compound with vyādhim

items.question: Which specific winds and diseases are claimed to be eliminated by this practice?
premises: The practice also destroys the disease of leprosy.
The repetition emphasizes the destructive effect on these ailments.
items.inference: This practice is asserted to eliminate both the eighty winds and leprosy.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the eighty winds is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: It destroys the eighty winds, and indeed destroys the disease of leprosy.
